_comment: Checkpoint provenance for jukebox-infer. Every checkpoint is a third-party OpenAI Jukebox release, downloaded at runtime from the Azure mirror below via jukebox_infer.utils.remote_utils.download and cached under ~/.cache/jukebox/models/ (never bundled in this package). URLs and approximate sizes are transcribed from jukebox_infer/hparams.py's HPARAMS_REGISTRY (restore_vqvae/restore_prior fields) and download_checkpoints.sh, current as of the ADOPT campaign (feat/adopt-constitution, 2026-07-11). sha256 is intentionally NOT recorded here: computing it requires downloading all ~6.2-10GB of checkpoints, which this campaign explicitly avoided (heavy GPU/weights work is out of scope -- see repo CLAUDE.md). Only the '1b_lyrics' model is exercised/tested by this package today; '5b' and '5b_lyrics' entries exist in hparams.py but are not covered by any README workflow.
